description: Erection of a rear roof extension, involving an increase in the ridge height by 100mm; erection of a single storey side extension; replacement of all existing windows with white painted timber double glazed windows; reinstatement of front boundary black metal railings; and creation of a soft-landscaped front garden space.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).

Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:

- Walls: Off-white render to match the existing building in terms of colour, texture and appearance.
- Roofs and rear roof extension: Slate or slate appearance tiles to match the existing.
- Windows and doors: Timber framed, painted white, style, detail and finish to match the existing.
- Railings: Black painted metal railings

The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. 

Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate.

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 4 - The development shall be carried out and completed in full accordance with the details contained within the approved Flood Risk Assessment (dated July 2026). No part of the development shall be used or occupied until all flood resilience and SuDS measures have been installed in accordance with the submitted details and the development shall be permanently retained in this form and maintained as necessary thereafter. 

To limit the impact on flood risk and mitigate the susceptibility of the development to flooding in accordance with Policies CC2, CC3 and CC4 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 5 - No part of any roof of the extensions hereby approved shall be used as a roof terrace or other form of open amenity space. No alterations shall be carried out; nor planters or other chattels placed on the roofs. No railings or other means of enclosure shall be erected on the roofs, and no alterations shall be carried out to the property to form access onto these roofs.

Such a use would be detrimental to the amenities of neighbouring properties by reason of overlooking and loss of privacy and potential noise and disturbance, contrary to Policies CC11 and HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 6 - No water tanks, water tank enclosures or other structures (excluding solar panels and air source heat pumps) shall be erected upon the roofs of the extensions hereby permitted.  

It is considered that such structures would seriously detract from the appearance of the building, contrary to Policies DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 7 - The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until the completion of the following highways works:

- Removal of redundant part of vehicle crossover to Walham Grove.
- Reconstruction of footway along this section of Walham Grove.
- Extension of existing on-street parking bay on this side of the road along the frontage of the development.

In the interests of pedestrian and highway safety and to ensure the work is done to specific standard, in accordance with Policy T4 of the Local Plan (2018) and Key Principle - TR17 of the Planning Guidance Supplementary Planning Document (2018).

Condition : 8 - The gate to the front garden and bin store hereby approved shall not open outwards across the pavement and shall be permanently retained in this form.

In the interest of highway and pedestrian safety in accordance with policy T1 of the Local Plan (2018).
